{{Top}} {{Update|[[Reign of the Empire: The Mask of Fear]]}} {{Character |type=Galactic Empire |image=[[File:MaleDee-DoRVG.png]] |name=Malé-Dee |homeworld=[[Uyter]]''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' |birth= |death= |species=[[Human]]{{Film|III}} |gender=[[Gender|Male]] |pronouns=He/him |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Red]] |feathers= |eyes=Brown |skin=Fair |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Republic]]''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' **[[Delegation of 2,000]] *[[Galactic Empire]]''[[Reign of the Empire: The Mask of Fear]]'' **[[Imperial Senate]] |masters= |apprentices= }} '''Malé-Dee''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Politics|politician]] who served in the [[Galactic Senate|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] during the later stages of the [[Clone Wars]]. He was a member of the [[Delegation of 2,000]], a subgroup of the Senate which was concerned with [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]]'s conduct during the [[Cloning|Clone]] Wars. Malé-Dee was one of the [[senator]]s and officials who greeted Palpatine at the [[Imperial Executive Building|Senate Office Building]] after he returned from his [[Battle of Coruscant|rescue]] aboard the ''[[Invisible Hand]]'', above [[Coruscant]]. After Palpatine's [[Proclamation of the New Order|transformation]] of the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire]], he remained a part of the [[Imperial Senate]] but changed his stance on Palpatine. ==Biography== ===Senator of the Republic=== Malé-Dee, a [[Gender|male]] [[human]], was a [[senator]] serving the [[Galactic Senate]] in the late stages of the [[Clone Wars]]. He was also a member of the [[Delegation of 2,000]], a group of two thousand senators who grew concerned with how [[Supreme Chancellor|Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] was ruling the [[Galactic Republic]]. ===Palpatine's arrival=== {{Quote|Chancellor Palpatine. Are you alright?''"
"''Yes, thanks to your two Jedi Knights. They killed Count Dooku, but General Grievous has escaped once again.|Mace Windu and Chancellor Palpatine|}} [[File:Male-Dee_CVD.png|Dee in his senatorial robes|thumb|180px|right]] In [[19 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY]]. following the conclusion of the [[Battle of Coruscant]] and the [[death]] of [[Count]] [[Dooku]], Malé-Dee was one of the many [[Politics|politicians]] who greeted Chancellor Palpatine after he returned from his captivity aboard the ''[[Invisible Hand]]''. Palpatine arrived in front of the [[Imperial Executive Building|Senate Office Building]] by way of a [[Util-313]] [[speeder bus]], and was escorted by his saviors, [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker]]. [[File:SenateGreetingParty.png|thumb|left|250px|Malé-Dee among the senators awaiting Palpatine's return]] In the group of politicians, Malé-Dee stood to the left of his fellow Delegation member, the [[Mon Calamari]] [[Meena Tills]].{{Databank|meena-tills|Meena Tills}} After Palpatine departed the shuttle bus, Malé-Dee moved forward with his constituents to greet him. The group of senators turned around to return into the office building, and Malé-Dee conversed with [[Nee Alavar]], another member of the Delegation of 2,000. Palpatine emerged at the front of the group to announce the results of the battle to [[Jedi]] Master [[Mace Windu]]. With Malé-Dee and his fellow senators behind him, Palpatine announced that Dooku had been killed and that [[General]] [[Grievous]] had eluded capture. As a member of the Delegation of 2,000, Malé-Dee was one of the two thousand senators who signed the [[Petition of 2,000]], a document formally complaining about the Chancellor's conduct. The document also requested that he relinquish his emergency powers, granted to him at the beginning of the Clone Wars, to the Senate following its conclusion. ===War's end=== {{Quote|The people have spoken. What does it matter if I believe they are wrong, when I am their sworn servant? Is it not the truest act of democracy to trust the public will?|Malé-Dee to Mon Mothma|}} One [[Standard day|day]] after Palpatine [[Proclamation of the New Order|transformed]] the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire]] and made himself its [[Emperor]], sixty-three members of the Delegation were [[Senatorial arrests|arrested]] on counts of [[treason]]. It is unknown if Malé-Dee was among those arrested.''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]'' Afterwards he gave in and changed his stance on Palpatine and as fellow leading Delegation of 2,000 member [[Mon Mothma]] courted him for her [[Imperial Rebirth Act]] that would lessen the Emperor's power, he declined her. Later that year Malé-Dee was a guest at the Imperial [[COMPNOR-Alpha summit]], where he was part of a tour group led by the newly appointed [[Governor]] [[Rhaygus Strentine]]. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:Male-Dee2000.jpg|thumb|200px|Malé-Dee as he appeared in Episode III's deleted scene]] [[Kee Chan]] portrayed Malé-Dee in a brief appearance in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]. The character's name is given in the film's closing credits. Dee also appeared in a deleted scene in which the Delegation of 2,000 spoke to Chancellor Palpatine in his office. The character first appeared in the film's now [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|novelization]] as a member of the [[Delegation of 2000]],[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]] novelization in which the deleted scene featuring Malé-Dee and other members of the delegation addressing Chancellor Palpatine was adapted. ==Appearances== *{{Film|III}} {{1st}} *''[[Reign of the Empire: The Mask of Fear]]'' {{Ab|Reign of the Empire: The Mask of Fear (audiobook)}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles]]'' {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' {{Po}} *{{SWKidsYouTube|series=Star Wars By the Numbers|text=Every Droid in Star Wars|video=UQg6aX7lqTA|nolive=1}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|The End of the Clone Wars}} {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' *{{Databank|orn-free-taa|Orn Free Taa}} {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Malé-Dee |tr=Malé-Dee |uk=Мале-Ді }} [[Category:Delegation of 2,000]] [[Category:Galactic Empire senators]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Males]]
